correctness.rationale: All intrinsic normals are centered. Sorting the normal yields the exact top-r-minus-bottom-r support width. Positive gap decomposition into centered two-level rays and strict Euclidean triangle inequality give a universal lower bound attained only on single extremal rays. Ratio monotonicity reduces minima to the singleton or balanced split. Parity-polynomial comparisons rigorously yield a unique odd transition at \(n=4r^2-1\). A standalone executable reproduced 12320 exact rational comparisons, 25540 rays and 65800 random checks; the infinite theorem is justified by proof, not sampling.
